patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 serializes Part.blend_mode as an integral enum but deserializes it as a string, preventing genuine Part-containing puppets produced by inWriteINPPuppet from being reopened for M1 real-artifact inspection.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision can round-trip its own Part.blend_mode output without this compatibility patch.

patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 JSON deserialization treats nulib nstring as a D string and uses cast(T)data.str, bypassing nstring ownership/copy semantics and leaving metadata/node names backed by transient JSON memory after inLoadPuppet returns.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision deserializes nulib nstring values through an owning constructor/assignment and loaded strings remain valid after JSON parser storage is released.

patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 passes nulib nstring directly to std.uni.toLower when rebuilding Parameter.indexableName; the alias conversion reaches std.uni with invalid range behavior for loaded parameter names. Passing the owned D-string view explicitly preserves the same lowercase semantics without the bounds failure.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision can finalize a loaded Parameter with nstring names without a std.uni bounds failure.

patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 duplicates PuppetMeta serialization inside Puppet.onSerialize and assigns nulib nstring values directly into std.json, so whole-puppet JSON loses metadata even though PuppetMeta.onSerialize itself is corrected. Serialize the duplicated fields from their stable D-string views.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision serializes Puppet metadata through one nstring-safe path and inToJson(Puppet) preserves metadata strings without this compatibility patch.

patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 serializes vec2 arrays such as MeshData verts/uvs as nested JSON arrays, while the generic vector-array deserializer assumes a flat float array and calls get!float on each nested array. Accept the serializer's nested representation while retaining the legacy flat-vector path.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision can round-trip non-empty MeshData vec2 arrays produced by its own serializer without this compatibility patch.

patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 routes all scalar tryGet values through JSONValue.get!float, so uint sentinel values such as Part.NO_TEXTURE (4294967295) lose precision and reload as texture slot 0, incorrectly duplicating albedo into emissive and bumpmap. Integral scalar reads must use JSON integer/uinteger accessors.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision preserves full signed/unsigned integer precision in serde tryGet and Part texture NO_TEXTURE sentinels round-trip without becoming slot 0.
